question: was the frozen planned route executable inside the frozen step budget under the declared nominal kinematic limits, BEFORE accounting for controller tracking inefficiency?

acceleration_limits.evidence: KinematicDriver.step clamps velocity only; there is no acceleration term in src/navfm/collection/kinematic_drive.py, and BaseLimits.clamp bounds max_v / max_vy / max_w and nothing else

translation_and_rotation_overlap.evidence: integrate_se2 applies vx and wz in the same step, so heading change and translation are simultaneous
translation_and_rotation_overlap.consequence: angular time is NOT added to translational time; the bound uses the max of the two

speed_law.turn_in_place_regime: when |heading_err| > 75 deg, vx = 0.05 * cruise_v = 0.0175 m/s and wz = +/- max_w
speed_law.consequence_for_q1: the controller can never command more than cruise_v, so a bound computed at max_v is unreachable in practice and is reported as a mathematical floor only

step_cadence.one_collector_step: one control update, one physics step and one rendered observation
step_cadence.evidence: the collection shim calls SimulationContext.step(render=True) once per control update, and the context was created with physics_dt = rendering_dt = 1/hz

A_absolute_translational_lower_bound.assumes: instantaneous acceleration, no turn penalty, travel at max_v
A_absolute_translational_lower_bound.why: the controller never commands more than cruise_v; this is a mathematical floor

A2_bound_at_commanded_cruise_ceiling.assumes: perfect tracking at the maximum speed the controller can command

B_kinematic_lower_bound_with_frozen_limi.combination: max(translation, rotation) because they overlap; NOT additive

B_tol_goal_tolerance_adjusted.note: the final 0.2 m need not be traversed to enter the success region

sensitivity_descriptive_only.descriptive_only: no new max_steps value is proposed from these numbers

milestone_unaffected.note: Q1 explains a recorded failure; it does not revise a compatibility claim
